Typography uses Azeret Semimono (a semi-monospace font) for headlines and UI elements, reinforcing the code-centric, technical aesthetic typical of digital Brutalism. The layout features generous whitespace and centered symmetric compositions, but the raw material honesty comes through in the high-contrast color blocking, minimal decoration, and the unpolished quality of using system-default blue. # Taste — design system

Design system extracted from tastelabs.com using Taste Labs' Engine.

## Overview

- **Brand:** Taste
- **Source:** https://tastelabs.com
- **Page:** Core Marketing / Homepage
- **Industry:** SaaS / AI
- **Primary purpose:** Position Taste as the infrastructure layer for AI taste and judgment, attract enterprise clients for model training and agent integration, and recruit technical and creative talent
- **Main CTA:** Try the API

## Brand identity

Dark, monochromatic design with stark contrast between deep blacks (#1e1e1e, #111) and off-white/cream (#f5f7f2) sections. Bold, modern typography combining Matter sans-serif with Azeret Mono for technical credibility. Animated 3D card carousels, Lottie animations, and interactive elements create a sophisticated, research-lab aesthetic.

- **Copy tone:** Intellectual, Mission-driven, Technical
- **Visual keywords:** monochromatic, technical, editorial, research-driven, sophisticated, minimal
- **Accent strategy:** Minimal accent color use; relies primarily on high contrast between black backgrounds and white/cream text with subtle grey (#8b8b8b) for secondary content. Occasional blue (#002bba) appears in interactive elements.
- **Visual highlights:** 3D rotating card carousels, Lottie SVG animations for mission visualization, draggable team marquee, and interactive swipe-based footer game create dynamic focal points against static dark backgrounds

### Style

**Brutalism** (secondary: Corporate)

### Strategy

Taste's visual identity deliberately positions the company as a serious research institution rather than a typical startup, using monochromatic palettes and technical typography to signal credibility in the nascent field of AI taste infrastructure. The dark, lab-like aesthetic reinforces their mission to 'end AI slop' by visually demonstrating sophisticated judgment. Interactive elements (3D carousels, swipe interfaces) serve dual purposes: showcasing product capabilities while engaging visitors in the core value proposition of subjective evaluation. The prominent careers section and team photography humanize the technical mission, targeting both enterprise buyers and talent simultaneously.

**Target audience**

- AI/ML engineers and researchers seeking infrastructure solutions for subjective domain evaluation in model training
- Enterprise product teams building AI agents or applications that require aesthetic judgment and brand consistency
- Technical and creative professionals considering careers at the intersection of AI and design/taste evaluation

- **Classification:** centered symmetric, generous whitespace
- **Grid:** 12 columns, 2rem gutter, 90rem max width
- **Section separation:** Sections alternate between deep black (#1e1e1e), off-white/cream (#f5f7f2), pure white, and extra-dark black (#111). Transitions use gradient overlays (hero-bg, api-gradient) and generous vertical padding (9rem desktop, 4rem mobile). Horizontal strokes with gray opacity separate content blocks within sections. Navigation color transitions (nav-black-to-white, nav-white-to-dark-black) create visual continuity across color-block sections.

### Notes

- High-contrast color blocking (black/white/cream) creates bold section rhythm; each major section is a distinct color zone with deliberate palette shifts.
- Generous vertical spacing (9rem default desktop padding) and centered layouts emphasize breathing room and hierarchy; mobile collapses to 4rem padding with stacked layouts.
- Interactive 3D elements (carousel, draggable marquee, card swiper footer) add depth and engagement while maintaining clean, minimal structure; Lottie animations and GSAP transitions enhance cinematic feel.
- Typography scale uses fluid clamp() for responsive sizing (global-headline-l: 2.5rem → 4rem); Azeret Semimono for UI, Matter for body, creating a modern, technical aesthetic.
- Grid system is flexible: strict 12-column for desktop, collapses to single-column mobile, with intermediate 8-column tablet; custom 24-column grid available for fine-grained layouts.
